summary: Crypto sentiment is cautiously constructive despite the reported Binance hack: Bitcoin remains under pressure, but many altcoins are outperforming BTC and Michaël van de Poppe views this resilience as a strong sign. Macro sentiment is mixed, with oil elevated and gold weakening as markets price greater odds of a December rate hike.
